no worker has a device this run would use: 2 device(s) across 1 worker(s), none usable: 2 declined by available: the probe refused it: RAIDMember (a member of the MD RAID array md0 (raid0)), Busy (the kernel refused an exclusive open: md0 holds it). GKE assembled the local SSDs into that array, which is what a node pool created with ephemeral-storage-local-ssd does; a pool created with local-nvme-ssd-block attaches them as raw devices instead
